nodes.name: Cron: every 15m (or webhook)
nodes.notes: POLL trigger. In production replace with a webhook for ad-hoc intakes. Inputs are normalized source jobs queued externally.

nodes.name: POST /api/automation/deduplicate
nodes.notes: Reuses the existing automation dedupe endpoint. Returns run_id which we use for the editorial hook downstream.

nodes.name: POST /api/automation/editorial-item
nodes.notes: Creates (or reuses) the editorial_item via the existing automation hook. Returns editorial_item_id, stage=editorial_created.

nodes.name: Promote FF90-01 output
nodes.notes: Phase 18G: terminal promote node. Re-emits the canonical envelope to MASTER so run_id and editorial_item_id are not lost to the Audit log response.
